$comment: Cross-SDK conformance vectors for the server-sent events framing utility in each IndeRun core (packages/inderun-web/src/core/sse.ts, ios/.../IndeRunCore/SSE.swift, android/.../core/Sse.kt). The three parsers are separate implementations of one protocol, so they are held to one set of vectors rather than three hand-written test suites that could drift. 'chunksHex' are the raw bytes as they arrive from the streaming HTTP host capability, hex-encoded so a case can place a chunk boundary inside a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence. Absent 'event'/'id' on an expected entry mean the field was not present in the stream. Behavior follows the WHATWG server-sent events stream parsing rules, minus reconnection: 'retry' is parsed as a field and ignored, and no Last-Event-ID reconnect logic exists.

cases.name: single_data_event
cases.description: A lone data field terminated by a blank line dispatches one event with no type.

cases.name: named_event_with_id
cases.description: event and id fields are carried alongside data.

cases.name: multi_line_data_is_newline_joined
cases.description: Repeated data fields accumulate, separated by a single newline, with no trailing newline.

cases.name: comments_are_ignored
cases.description: Lines starting with a colon are comments (commonly used as keep-alives) and never dispatch.

cases.name: crlf_and_cr_line_endings
cases.description: CRLF and bare CR terminate lines exactly like LF.

cases.name: event_split_across_chunks
cases.description: A chunk boundary falling inside a field line must not lose or duplicate data.

cases.name: chunk_boundary_splits_utf8_sequence
cases.description: A boundary inside a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence must decode correctly once the rest arrives. The euro sign is 0xE2 0x82 0xAC.

cases.name: blank_line_without_data_dispatches_nothing
cases.description: A field-less blank line resets the buffers without dispatching.

cases.name: only_one_leading_space_is_stripped
cases.description: A single space after the colon is field syntax; any further space is data.

cases.name: field_without_colon_has_empty_value
cases.description: A bare field name is the field with an empty value, so a lone 'data' line dispatches an empty-data event.

cases.name: unknown_fields_are_ignored
cases.description: Fields outside the SSE vocabulary are dropped rather than treated as errors.

cases.name: trailing_incomplete_event_is_not_dispatched
cases.description: A stream that ends without a blank line leaves the pending event undispatched; a truncated event must never be reported as complete.

cases.name: sentinel_data_is_passed_through_verbatim
cases.description: The parser frames only; sentinels such as [DONE] are the caller's concern.

cases.name: consecutive_events_in_one_chunk
cases.description: One chunk may carry several complete events, all of which dispatch in order.
